label: Exemplified EXISTENCE_6: an object exemplifies the property E!
definition: ExemplifiesExistence F x: x exemplifies the frame's existence property E! (concrete), in the ordinary mode of having a property. Under this reconstruction's carrier choice, the beings (the domain over which the root's existence claims are read) are the objects that exemplify E!, i.e. the concrete objects; an object that does not exemplify E! is 'not among the beings' only in that sense. In Zalta's theory the quantifier ranges over abstract objects too, so they exist in the quantificational sense.
note: Analyst reconstruction in the style of Zalta, attribution deferred. Lean defines it as the frame's Exemplifies applied to concrete. Distinct from EXISTENCE_7 (encoding E!), which comprehension confers on characterized abstract objects; the encoding control shows that the characterized god has EXISTENCE_7 and never EXISTENCE_6.
